title: Conditional GAN results trail non-conditional GANs
description: The conditional adversarial net results are comparable to some other network-based approaches but are outperformed by several other approaches, including non-conditional adversarial nets; the results are presented as a proof-of-concept rather than a demonstration of efficacy, with better performance expected from further hyperparameter and architecture exploration.
